name.jp: ステラ・ヴァーミリオン

titles: 法米利昂皇国第二公主

status.relationship: Ikki's girlfriend and rival by end of volume

appearance.overview: A striking foreign beauty with ruby eyes and vivid flame-red hair.

attire.combat: Laevateinn, a flaming two-handed sword; Empress Dress flame mantle

distinctive: fiery aura and scattered sparks when emotional

personality.summary: Proud, passionate, easily embarrassed, but fundamentally brave and fair-minded.
fears: becoming complacent as a praised genius
desires: win the Seven Stars Sword Art Festival
stand beside and eventually fight Ikki
personality.inner_conflict: She wants to be recognized for effort rather than merely talent and learns to respect Ikki's different kind of strength.

decision_pattern.crisis: protects innocents first even at personal cost

voice.self_reference: 我 / 本公主 when angry
quote_samples: 不要用你们放弃的理由去否定一辉的强悍！
我这次绝对不会再输给你！

habits.daily_routine: Joins Ikki's severe morning runs despite hardship.
quirks: takes her self-imposed servant promise too seriously

background.upbringing: Praised as a rare genius but trained hard after struggling to control flames that burned her own body.

education.entry: highest entrance score in school history

formative_events: spent three years mastering Dragon Breath
left home to avoid stagnation and seek stronger opponents
background.pre_story: Came to Japan before the entrance ceremony as a foreign exchange student.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Initially angry roommate and duel opponent; becomes the person she admires, loves, and promises to challenge again.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Jealous rival for Ikki's attention but comes to respect her during the hostage incident.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Acquaintance who helps during the mall outing.
relationships.shizuya-kirihara: Despises his cowardly hunting style and bets on Ikki's victory.

secrets: Falls in love with Ikki before openly admitting it; worries about whether he finds her attractive.
periods.summary: Stella arrives as an A-rank princess and top freshman, accidentally becomes Ikki's roommate, loses to him in a duel, and chooses to remain his room partner. She trains with him, clashes with Shizuku, protects hostages during the Rebellion incident at the cost of public humiliation, wins her first selection battle by intimidation, publicly defends Ikki against jeering spectators, and accepts his confession under the moon.

key_events.summary: Is seen changing by Ikki and reacts with fury.
Loses to Ikki's Ittou Shura and begins respecting him.
Reveals herself to save a mother and child from Rebellion gunfire.
Her overwhelming flame pressure makes Momotani surrender immediately.
Accepts Ikki's love and vows to meet him in the final.

periods.label: 初吻后的红莲皇女

name.jp: ステラ・ヴァーミリオン

titles: 法米利昂皇国第二皇女
破军学园一年一班A级骑士

status.selection_battle_record: continues undefeated, including a decisive win over Saiyo Rai
status.relationship: secretly dating Ikki; first kiss with him occurs at a public pool

appearance.overview: Tall red-haired foreign princess with exceptional beauty, strength and appetite.
distinctive: very revealing black bikini at pool

personality.summary: Proud, passionate and sincere; her confidence in battle contrasts with awkward insecurity as Ikki's girlfriend.
values: face unknown enemies without overreliance on scouting
fears: Ikki losing interest because their relationship stalls
public scandal from her royal romance
desires: meet Ikki again on the Seven Stars stage

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Boyfriend; they overcome mutual fear of rejection and kiss at the pool.
relationships.ayase-ayatsuji: Potential rival turned confidante; Ayase advises her to be honest with Ikki.
relationships.kuraudo-kurashiki: Recognizes him as a dangerous but honest battle maniac.

periods.summary: Stella defeats Saiyo Rai with raw power and continues undefeated. She is jealous when Ikki trains Ayase, but Ayase later tricks her into admitting her relationship with Ikki and encourages her to express what she wants. Stella and Ikki argue from mutual fear, realize they both want intimacy, and share their first kiss. During the Kuraudo duel, Stella sees that Ikki, Kaito and Kuraudo share a warrior's joy in deadly combat, helping Ayase understand her father.

key_events.summary: Crushes Hagun's fourth-ranked Saiyo Rai and his ten-ton strike.
Confesses her fear, hears Ikki's desire, and kisses him.
Helps Ayase realize Kaito wanted the Kuraudo duel as a swordsman.
Learns Shizuku's next opponent is Toka Todo.

periods.label: 红莲皇女的支援与约定

name.jp: ステラ・ヴァーミリオン

titles: 法米利昂皇国第二皇女
破军学园一年级A级伐刀者

status.current: qualifies for the Seven Stars Sword-Art Festival and accepts Ikki's proposal to become his family

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Lover; she struggles with desire and public scrutiny but refuses to abandon their bond, wins her own match in seconds, and rushes to encourage him.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Rival for Ikki's affection and gradually trusted ally; Shizuku attacks her to snap her out of despair.
relationships.toka-todo: Receives care from Toka during the Okutama incident and learns from Toka's balanced sword-and-ability style.
relationships.vermillion-king: Father whose approval becomes politically crucial; Stella fears his overprotectiveness but wants to introduce Ikki proudly.

periods.summary: Stella watches Shizuku's match, supports her rival from the stands, and later secretly continues her romance with Ikki. During the Okutama investigation she catches a severe summer cold, is cared for by Ikki in a mountain hut, and discusses intimacy, marriage order, and meeting each other's parents. The leaked kiss photo turns her relationship into a manufactured scandal; she briefly blames herself and considers separation, but Shizuku violently reminds her that Ikki is defending their love. Stella then resolves to fight in her own way: she wins her final selection battle in three seconds, arrives in time to encourage Ikki, and after his victory accepts his proposal. When Akaza tries to interfere, she casually knocks him away while carrying Ikki to treatment.

key_events.summary: Falls ill during the mountain search and discusses future family meetings with Ikki.
Is shaken by the scandal until Shizuku forces her to face Ikki's resolve.
Wins her final match immediately and brings her representative medal to Ikki.
Accepts Ikki's request that she become his family.

abilities: learns the principle of Nuk足/Ash-walking well enough to use it on Akaza

periods.time: A day secretly observed by Kagami
periods.label: 史黛菈篇秘密跟踪采访

name.jp: ステラ・ヴァーミリオン

titles: 法米利昂皇国第二公主

status.current: continues severe daily training with Ikki
status.public_profile: known as an overwhelming magic-focused Blazer who still practices basic physical training

physical.weight: 51 kg, according to Kagami's obtained health-check data

personality.summary: Diligent and passionate, but privately very lovestruck toward Ikki.
quirks: secretly enjoys Ikki's scent when she thinks no one is watching

habits.daily_routine: Wakes around 5 a.m., runs with Ikki, attends ordinary classes, eats lunch with Ikki, Shizuku and Alice, then trains by weights or sword swings when no selection match is scheduled.

preferences.food: eats an enormous amount; the cafeteria considers adding a rice cooker just for her

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Morning-run and training partner; her private affection is exposed when she sniffs his shirt while he is away.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Regular lunch companion alongside Ikki and Alice.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Regular lunch companion in the four-person group.
relationships.kagami-kusakabe: Subject of Kagami's secret profile; Kagami captures an embarrassing photo but withholds publication because of Stella's status.

periods.summary: Kagami's Stella profile shows that Stella wakes unexpectedly early, runs at a punishing pace with Ikki, studies Japanese well enough to use normal textbooks, sometimes misunderstands Japanese culture, eats more than the other three lunch companions combined, and spends free afternoons training. The profile also reveals a private romantic habit: when Ikki leaves his shirt nearby, Stella smells it with a blissful expression.

key_events.summary: Her full day is observed from dawn run to afternoon training and an embarrassing private moment.

periods.label: 红莲皇女第一次体会弱小

name.jp: ステラ・ヴァーミリオン

titles: 法米利昂皇国第二公主
破军学园七星剑武祭代表

status.current: enters a one-week hell training under Nene Saikyo after being overpowered by Ouma
status.training_record: goes 3-3 against Toka at the joint camp but still feels inferior

personality.summary: Proud, passionate and hardworking; her confidence is shaken when Toka and Ouma reveal limits she had never felt before.
personality.inner_conflict: She wants to reach the place promised with Ikki but realizes her current strength may not be enough.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Lover/fiance; she delights in his possessiveness and asks him to protect Shizuku during the crisis.
relationships.toka-todo: Senior rival and training opponent who defeats and teaches her; later knocks her out to force evacuation.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: Fellow A-rank student whose Kusanagi overpowers her Salamander and causes her first deep experience of weakness.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Seeks her out for a brutal one-week special training before Seven Stars.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Rival for Ikki and ally during Akatsuki attack.

periods.summary: Stella spends the joint camp challenging Toka, ending with an even 3-3 record but no satisfaction because she still feels Toka's superiority. On a jog and shopping trip with Ikki she enjoys his new possessive affection and meets Amane during the random-killer incident. When Akatsuki attacks Hagun, Stella accepts Ouma's challenge as the only Hagun A-rank who can face him. Ouma's Kusanagi overpowers her Calusaritio Salamander, and Toka knocks Stella unconscious to preserve her as a Seven Stars representative. The defeat leaves Stella anguished by the pain of being weak, so she asks Nene for a week of hellish training before the tournament.

key_events.summary: Learns from repeated camp duels that she still cannot decisively surpass Toka.
Shares a romantic outing with Ikki and witnesses the Amane incident.
Her strongest fire sword is overpowered by Ouma's wind sword; Toka saves and evacuates her.
Seeks Nene's brutal special training to break through before Seven Stars.
